description.en: The IDs of the NAS file systems.

description.zh: 是否在查询结果中仅包含只支持UPM的NAS文件系统。
description.en: Specifies whether to return only NAS file systems that are compatible with User Profile Management (UPM).

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。    

- 最大值：100。    
- 默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

- Maximum value: 100.

- Default value: 10.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of `NextToken`.
The ID of the office network.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) is available.
